BiocAgentSkills package overview

Vince Carey

Source: vignettes/BiocAgentSkills.Rmd
BiocAgentSkills.Rmd

Introduction

It is a premise of this package that R package discipline should be used to manage documents that are intended to serve as “skills” for agentic software engineering and analysis in the Bioconductor ecosystem.

Structure

inst/demoskills hold drafts of skills for automated evaluation in the development of this package

inst/evaluation_support holds scripts and a README.md to describe how an evaluation report is produced.

inst/resources is a folder tree with various skill documents and documentation to support diverse agents and agentic processes.

Package vignettes provide more details on an approach to skill evaluation.
